generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The intending bidder should have the experience as a prime contractor, in executing at least one I&C Periodical Special Assistance/AOH/MOH Maintenance works compulsorily in any thermal power stations of capacity of not less than 210MW. As a proof of this single work order/work done certificate of value not less than Rs 25.87 Lakhs in any one of the preceding five years (i.e, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). Relevant documents shall be uploaded in this regard.(Previous years Work order/Work done certificate shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year 2026-27)
The Intending Bidder should be a Class-I or above electrical contractor. As a proof of this, valid Electrical license issued by Competent Authority of Govt of Karnataka shall be uploaded.

The intending bidder in his name should have achieved minimum average annual financial turnover of Rs 51.74 Lakhs in at least any two of the preceding financial years (i.e, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26).As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload the certified copy of the profit and loss statement OR turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered accountant.(Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of financial year 2026-27)

itemList.description: Supervision of I&C maintenance works
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of Flame Scanner System of 210MW Unit
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of SADC system (Secondary Air Damper Control) of 210MW Unit
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of HEA Ignition system and Nozzle/Trip Valvesof 210MW Unit.
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of Gravimetric Feeder System
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of Acoustic Stem Leak Detection System (ASTLD)of 210MW Unit
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of FOPH, CWPH of 210MW Unit
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of OLCS I&C equipments like HT/LT Pumps, Fans, Blowers etc.,
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of SWAS System
Routine/Regular Inspection of 2X110VA UPS System.
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of Compressed Air System (IAC/SAC/Dryers) pertaining to Main plant
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of Main Turbine governing system,HP &LP bypass system
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of Lube oil systems of ID/FD/PA Fans & MILLs
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of Master Clock System
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of DCS control panels, HMI System and LVS system.
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of OLCS I&C equipments like Electrical actuators / Motor operated valves
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of CLCS I&C equipments like Dampers, Control valves, ON-OFF Pneumatic Actuators
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending problems of Oxygen analysers
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending problems of BFP systems
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending problems of Generartor instrumetation systems like PW system, Seal oil system, H2 gas system etc.,
Routine/Regular Inspection and attending Problems of Electronic Water Level Indicator(EWLI) system.
Purging of impulse piping of Transmitters / switches. (Air, Steam, Water and Flue gas applications)
One visit of Unforeseen unit Emergency works or any other assistance works as and when required for carrying out the work.
One visit of Boiler Lightup and Unit synchronization as and when required for carrying out the work.
Cable termination & Wiring - Inspection of wiring, Ferruling, Crimping of lugs, Connections up to marshalling box & Control panel.
Laying of control cables from equipments to control panels.
OFC Splicing / termination & checking the connectivity works
Painting of Local LIE's, LIR's and Junction Boxes
Checking, Servicing and calibration of pneumatic actuator & its instruments like Dampers, Control valves, ON-OFF valves
Checking, Servicing and calibration of Electrical actuators / Motor operated valves.
Checking, Servicing and calibration of Main Turbine governing system, HP & LP bypass system consisting of drives, field instruments and its control system.
Checking, Servicing and Calibration of Vibration pickups, Expansion pickups, TSI/VMS sensors.
Checking, Servicing and calibration of Transmitters (Pressure, Flow, Level & DP).
Checking, Servicing and Calibration of Temperature Elements (RTD's/Thermocouples/Temp transmitter).
Checking, Servicing and calibration of Switches (like Limit, Level, Pressure, Temp, Flow etc.,)
Checking, Servicing and Calibration of Guages (Pressure / Temperature / Level).
Isolation of I&C connections, normalisation and recommissioning of drives like Pumps, Motors, Valves, equipments.
Checking, servicing solenoid valves.
Welding of impulse lines, Route valves,Y-traps and other field instruments.
